experiments.input_change: Added sorted reviewed aliases and speaker-free enclosing utterance context while keeping closed enums and code-owned assembly unchanged.
experiments.rationale: The input specification improved the measured result over the recorded 4/11 baseline, but four classification mismatches and four slot mismatches remain. This is evidence for better source context, not proof of model adequacy.

candidates.rationale: The 2026-08-09 Meridian fixture returned a non-Mermaid pseudo-DSL, changed flow semantics, and duplicated a flow.

Raw-transcript and one-shot graph projection trials duplicated entities, produced self-loops, reversed analytics endpoints, and changed exact labels. After deterministic alias and atomic-relation normalization, duplicate closed-set classification and slot trials passed for a relation, attribute, and uncertainty on 2026-08-09; the missing-evidence and disagreement paths fail closed. A full live corpus trial accepted 4 facts and queued 11 (including the intentionally missing-evidence fact), so this model is not promoted for corpus-wide extraction. It remains advisory and cannot serialize or mutate the maintained graph. Re-measured on 2026-08-09 against the same model digest, seed 20260809, and identical options, the same corpus accepted 6 and queued 9: the Ollama runtime binary sha256 had changed from acecd6ca61310c1329fed95d38ccfe05cf8d5fddbc28304fa46629e96d03c318 to 1891afef04c07d24656c3da8ad44eca66057f5849a633849f4f5894a9432198e while still reporting version 0.32.6, so --expected-digest gates the weights but not the inference runtime, and cross-runtime reproducibility is therefore unproven. Five consecutive runs on one runtime were identical, so within-runtime reproducibility holds and the duplicate-call gate cannot detect runtime drift. Reversing the entity order in current-state.normalized.json -- a semantically null edit -- flipped rel-current-05 from accepted to slot-mismatch until the slot prompt was made order-invariant; after that fix the corpus accepts 5 and queues 10 identically under reordering. Determinacy analysis shows 0 of 10 reviewed relations are uniquely determined by the evidence fragment plus the {id,name,kind} registry and predicate contracts the model actually receives (2 to 86 admissible triples each), so slot-mismatch counts measure guessing under an under-specified input, not model capability.
